name: read_file
description: Read text file content with line numbers (supports offset/limit for large files)

name: read_file_lines
description: Read selected lines from a file

params.paths: array of relative file paths, max 50

name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite a text file

name: create_file
description: Create a new text file; fails if it exists (pass overwrite: true to force)

name: edit_file
description: Replace exact text in a file (supports multi-line and Windows CRLF)

name: apply_patch
description: Apply exact-match edits to one file atomically

name: delete_file
description: Delete a file or directory (supports recursive: true)

name: open_app
description: Launch/open a Windows application, document, file, or URL (e.g. notepad, calc, code, output.mp3)

params.app: app name, executable, or file path

name: close_app
description: Close/terminate a running Windows application by process name (e.g. notepad, calc)

name: list_apps
description: List currently running Windows applications and active windows

name: run_command
description: Execute a shell/terminal command or script in Windows and get stdout/stderr

params.command: shell command to run (e.g. python script.py, pip install x)
